lead: Anthropic's IPO is the story: S-1 details, a $1.1T to $1.75T valuation range, and METR plus Cotra arguing its AI-driven research acceleration may already cross its own threshold. A PSI system using a non-public Anthropic model claims a proof of the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture, and Asian markets and Big Tech kept sliding on data-center fears.

sections.title: The selloff
sections.intro: Nasdaq 100 loses a record $2.3T and investors question Anthropic's IPO price.

sections.title: The new open contender
sections.intro: Thinking Machines launches Inkling 2 Small with weights promised next week and raises $5B.

sections.title: The acceleration question
sections.intro: METR's assessment, with most evidence redacted, puts Anthropic's progress at about 2x.

sections.title: The leaky harness
sections.intro: Claude Code put users' emails in web headers; Anthropic added a blocking mod. Cuban says Facebook knowingly runs deepfake scam ads.

sections.title: The money keeps moving
sections.intro: Airbnb's option on Chesky's stealth AI lab.

sections.title: The agent desk
sections.intro: Perplexity ships always-on Teammates, and Google stretches Omni video to 15 seconds.

sections.title: The chip border
sections.intro: Nvidia tracks chips in Southeast Asia and TSMC weighs 3D DRAM.

sections.title: The reskilling case
sections.intro: Microsoft offers 60,000 buyouts as AI spending rises.

sections.title: The research shelf
sections.intro: How scientists use Claude, NVIDIA's world-simulation models, and training handbooks.

sections.title: The data commons
sections.intro: AI scrapers are overwhelming university libraries.
